title.narrative: IYCN: PREVENT MALNUTRITION AMONGST GIRLS AND BOYS UNDER 2 YEARS

description.narrative: Government and other partners have increased capacity to deliver services and bring about behaviour change in infant and young child nutrition (IYCN) to prevent malnutrition amongst girls and boys under 2 years.

participating-org.narrative: ACTIONS FOR INTEGRATED NUTRITION HEALTH AND HOME ECONOMICS ORGANIZATION
AFGHAN HEALTH AND DEVELOPMENT SEVICES AHDS
DOPH TAKHAR DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH
ORGANIZATION FOR PROMOTION OF HEALTH AND COMMUNITY
ORGANIZATION FOR RESEARCH AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
SOCIAL ASSOCIATION FOR DEVELOPMENT OF AFGHANISTAN

mailing-address.narrative: United Nations Office Complex Jalalabad Road, Kabul, Afghanistan

description.narrative: Afghanistan

sector.narrative: Breastfeeding protection, promotion and support, including work on the Code of Marketing of Breastmilk Substitutes
CO/RO Supply - technical assistance and collaboration in supply chain, procurement of goods and services, and logistics
Diet diversity in early childhood, including complementary feeding, multiple micronutrient powders and lipid-based nutrition supplements
Micronutrient supplementation in early childhood, including vitamin A supplementation and deworming prophylaxis
National multisectoral strategies and plans to prevent stunting and wasting (excludes intervention specific strategies)
Strengthening data and national information systems, including routine systems, nutrition surveys and assessments (early childhood nutrition)
Technical assistance - Nutrition in early childhood
